source_url: https://arxiv.org/e-print/2203.03647 (LaTeX source of Umetsu et al. 2022, ApJ 934, 169, arXiv:2203.03647)
exact_query: Table 8 ('Best-fit parameters from the Chandra spectral deprojection analysis'), file table8.tex in the arXiv e-print tarball for 2203.03647
extraction: Transcribed verbatim from the published LaTeX table (table8.tex) in the arXiv e-print source. Asymmetric errors kept as separate low/high columns. r_in_kpc/r_out_kpc are the ONLY added columns: theta * 5.161905 kpc/arcsec, using the paper's own stated scale (1 arcmin = 216.8 h^-1 kpc, h=0.7) at z=0.375. No measured value was altered. Raw table8.tex kept in raw_paper_tables/a370_umetsu2022_table8.tex.
note: Abell 370 (z=0.375). Instrument: Chandra ACIS (archival). THIS IS A DEPROJECTED PROFILE: background-subtracted Chandra spectra in 0.4-7.0 keV were jointly fit in four concentric annuli and deprojected onto spherical shells ASSUMING SPHERICAL SYMMETRY (outer boundary condition set from a 200-400 arcsec annulus). Both n_e(r) AND T_gas(r) are given, and both are DEPROJECTED 3D quantities. Radial range 0-200 arcsec = 0-1032 kpc, in 4 shells only (coarse). NO core excision: the innermost shell starts at 0 arcsec. This is a MEASURED quantity; no hydrostatic mass is used or implied in this table.
reference: Umetsu, Ueda, Hsieh, Nonino, Chiu, Oguri, Molnar, Koekemoer, Tam (2022), 'Line-of-sight Elongation and Hydrostatic Mass Bias of the Frontier Fields Galaxy Cluster Abell 370', ApJ; arXiv:2203.03647, Table 8
caveat: Only 4 radial shells - much coarser than the ACCEPT/X-COP profiles for the other clusters.
